latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate videos from images with a controlled end frame.

- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC uploads up to 200MB for video creation.
- Session-based GPU video rendering; receive 1080p MP4 output in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic handling of authentication and session setup, including free credit tokens.
- Workflow includes image upload, AI-powered animation toward an ending image, and easy export.
- Built-in error handling for authentication, file limits, format issues, and export permissions.
- Summarizes timeline edits and guides users with clear status messages throughout the process.
